summary.intent: Generate an executable PLAN.md for cipher-box roadmap Phase 68.1 in gap-closure mode (--gaps), using the GSD plan-phase workflow to pattern-map identified gaps and spawn a planner agent, skipping research since gap closure reads VERIFICATION.md instead.
summary.outcome: The plan-phase workflow ran through initialization, hook resolution, UI gate, drift precheck, and pattern-mapping, then spawned a gsd-planner agent to produce the gap-closure plan for Phase 68.1; final PLAN.md content/verification result is not visible in the captured transcript.

repo: cipher-box GSD workflows live under .claude/gsd-core/workflows/ and reference shared UI conventions from .claude/gsd-core/references/ui-brand.md

ui-brand.md defines mandatory UI conventions for GSD orchestrator output: uniform stage banners ('GSD ► {STAGE}'), 62-char checkpoint boxes, fixed status symbols (✓ ✗ ◆ ○ ⚡ ⚠), and a 'Next Up' block after every major completion
Every subagent spawn announcement must include the literal phrase 'runs in a subagent' so silence during a 1-5 min agent run isn't mistaken for a freeze
workflow: GSD plan-phase --gaps mode skips the research stage entirely and instead reads VERIFICATION.md to drive gap closure, feeding a pattern-mapper hook fragment before the planner agent runs

plan-phase pipeline sequence: init → resolve plan:pre hooks/UI gate/validation artifacts → drift precheck + intel surface + planner contribution fragments → pattern-mapper hook fragment → pattern-map agent → gsd-planner agent

friction: plan-phase.md was read twice in succession with no apparent state change between reads, suggesting a possibly redundant tool call
